As the sun began to rise, casting its warm golden hues across the sky, you slowly opened your eyes. Blinking in confusion, you found yourself lying on a luxurious canopy bed adorned with delicate lace curtains. The surrounding room was lavishly decorated with elegant furniture and intricate tapestries. It took a moment for you to realize that something extraordinary had happened—you had been reincarnated into another world.

Looking down at yourself, you saw that you now inhabited the body of a noble girl, dressed in an exquisite gown befitting your new station. However, there was one problem: you were not the main character in this world, where all the male interests would fall in love with you. Instead, you found yourself inside the body of a notorious villainess known for her bratty, rude, and vulgar attitude. A rush of emotions flooded through you as you realized the magnitude of this unexpected twist of fate.

A sudden memory then surged into your mind—it must have been the memory of the original owner of this body you resided in. The coming-of-age party for Princess Lily at the Royal Castle, a highly anticipated event in the kingdom. As a noblewoman, it was your duty to attend and show your support for the young princess. Your 'father' had reminded you to attend the party and be on your best behavior, perhaps even gaining the favor of the King and Queen of Britannia in the process.

"My lady?" The maid called to you. "We need to get ready for the coming-of-age party for Princess Lily at the Royal Castle."
